definitions.explanation: Someone employed by a state or military organization to gather secret information. A formal term, used in news reporting and spy fiction.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{元|もと}{諜報員|ちょうほういん}だ。
examples.english: He is a former intelligence agent.

examples.japanese: {諜報員|ちょうほういん}として{十年|じゅうねん}{活動|かつどう}していた。
examples.english: He worked as an intelligence agent for ten years.

examples.japanese: {外交官|がいこうかん}を{装|よそお}っていた{諜報員|ちょうほういん}が{国外|こくがい}に{追放|ついほう}されたと{報道|ほうどう}された。
examples.english: It was reported that an intelligence agent posing as a diplomat had been expelled from the country.

notes:
{諜報|ちょうほう} (intelligence gathering) + {員|いん} (staff member). The word is neutral in itself, unlike スパイ, which can be used accusingly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {諜報員|ちょうほういん}を{送|おく}り{込|こ}む: to plant an intelligence agent
- {元|もと}{諜報員|ちょうほういん}: a former intelligence agent
- {諜報員|ちょうほういん}{活動|かつどう}: espionage activity

SIMILAR WORDS:
- スパイ: spy — the everyday loanword, more common in casual speech
- {工作員|こうさくいん}: covert operative — implies active sabotage or manipulation, not just information gathering
